reason: B offers the more physically credible density-reduction mechanism because Zr is substantially lighter yet chemically and structurally similar to Hf, making retention of the refractory solid solution more plausible than with Al, which risks ordering, secondary phases, embrittlement, and reduced high-temperature stability. B is nevertheless weakened by its unsupported claim of >50% baseline ductility and by lacking a quantitative density-reduction rejection threshold.
